evidence.claim: Films featuring both 'hidden_conspiracy' and 'loss_of_innocence' motifs had a median ROI of 5.685x across 13 films.
evidence.sql_query: SELECT motif_a, motif_b,       countMerge(sample_count) AS n_roi,       quantileMerge(0.5)(roi_median) AS roi_median,       countMerge(interest_sample_count) AS n_interest,       quantileMerge(0.5)(interest_pct_median) AS interest_median FROM mv_motif_pair_stats WHERE (motif_a = 'hidden_conspiracy' AND motif_b = 'loss_of_innocence')    OR (motif_a = 'loss_of_innocence' AND motif_b = 'hidden_conspiracy') GROUP BY motif_a, motif_b HAVING n_roi >= 8

caveats: Analogues were drawn from the mid budget band. The proposal has no budget of its own; this band was assumed for the comparison.
Analogues span 1990-2014 with no era filter. The dataset ends at 2014 because the plot corpus does, not because later films were excluded.
Attention reflects sustained Wikipedia lookups from 2015 onward, measured 1-25 years after release. It is not opening-weekend attention.
All analogue films were released between 1990 and 2014.
Interest figures measure sustained attention years after release, not opening reaction.
Applying a budget filter ($20M-$80M) reduced the sample size for the combined motif and archetype analysis from 41 to 13 films.
